name: p31-crypto-mcp
description: P31 Post-Quantum Crypto MCP Server — ML-DSA-65 signing (FIPS 204), ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation (FIPS 203), SD-JWT selective-disclosure credentials (RFC 9901), GNU Taler blind-signed payments, x402 micropayments (Coinbase), PQC audit. 12 tools.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519 hybrid keypair for post-quantum signing.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign data with ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519 composite signature. Returns hex-encoded signature.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Verify ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519 composite signature against data.

tools.name: kem_encapsulate
tools.description: X-Wing KEM: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) + X25519 hybrid encapsulate. Returns shared secret and ciphertext.

tools.name: kem_decapsulate
tools.description: X-Wing KEM: ML-KEM-768 + X25519 hybrid decapsulate. Returns shared secret.

tools.name: sd_jwt_issue
tools.description: Issue SD-JWT (RFC 9901) credential with selectively disclosable claims.

tools.name: sd_jwt_present
tools.description: Present SD-JWT credential with selective disclosure.

tools.name: taler_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw LOVE credits as GNU Taler blind-signed coins.

tools.name: taler_pay
tools.description: Pay with Taler blind-signed coins via exchange.

tools.name: x402_request
tools.description: Create x402 payment request (Coinbase) for MCP tool access.

tools.name: x402_accept
tools.description: Accept x402 payment and confirm tool access.

tools.name: pqc_audit
tools.description: Audit PQC readiness across ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768, SD-JWT, Taler, x402.
